teaser: Before the final review you lay every design choice side by side: SDK vs API, allowed vs disallowed, resume vs fork, stdio vs http vs sdk.
takeaways: allowed_tools pre-approves tools (it is not a whitelist); disallowed_tools is a hard block and wins when both name the same tool.
query() is a single exchange; ClaudeSDKClient is a persistent multi-turn session with interrupt. resume continues, fork_session branches.
Hooks are lifecycle events for all policy and telemetry; can_use_tool only decides unresolved permission requests.
MCP transports: stdio = local subprocess, http = remote streamable HTTP, sse = legacy remote streaming, sdk = in-process custom tools.
